main_body: Shrine building with large teal tiled roof, red beam/pillars, white plaster walls, and central doors
top_band: Teal ridge and pitched roof slope seen from above/front (rows 4 to 42), plus orange lintel beam top highlight at row 42
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened teal roof slope with ridge (rows 4-42) overhanging the vertical wall and doors below (rows 42-78). Row 42 has a bright orange front-edge highlight on the main beam, row 45-46 has dark eave/beam shadow, and the central doors and wall panels are recessed behind the pillars and shimenawa.

style.evidence: The roof tiles have 6 distinct teal value steps with individual tile highlights and deep joints; walls have subtle plaster speckle; doors have detailed lattice shading; outlines use dark teal, dark brown, and dark red-brown material tones matching the Beodeul standard.
